entities.name: MA PDU session
entities.description: Multi-access PDU session that can be established over 3GPP and/or non-3GPP access.

entities.name: QoS rules
entities.description: Set of rules defining QoS parameters for packet flows in a PDU session.

entities.name: QoS flow descriptions
entities.description: Set of descriptions defining QoS flow characteristics in a PDU session.

entities.name: Session-AMBR
entities.description: Aggregate Maximum Bit Rate for the entire PDU session.

entities.name: Non-3GPP access
entities.description: Access type using non-3GPP technologies such as Wi-Fi.

entities.name: PDN connection as user-plane resource
entities.description: PDN connection serving as user-plane resource for the MA PDU session.

entities.name: EPS bearer contexts
entities.description: EPS bearer contexts associated with PDN connection in MA PDU session.

entities.name: Extended protocol configuration options IE
entities.description: Information element carrying extended protocol configuration parameters.

relations.description: MA PDU session contains one set of QoS rules unless specific conditions apply.
MA PDU session contains one set of QoS flow descriptions unless specific conditions apply.
MA PDU session contains one session-AMBR unless specific conditions apply.
MA PDU session can be established over non-3GPP access.
MA PDU session can have PDN connection as user-plane resource.
MA PDU session with PDN connection resource maintains QoS parameters via EPS bearer contexts.
EPS bearer contexts maintain QoS parameters via extended PCO IE parameters received via PDN connection.
When MA PDU session is established over non-3GPP access and has PDN connection resource, UE maintains two sets of QoS parameters.
